note: brms arma(p = 2, q = 2), regression formulation, next to a varying intercept of h (crossed with the series g): J_lag up to 2, the MA recursion two lags deep, ar[1..2] and ma[1..2] unbounded; standata rows sorted by (g, t) (J_1 and Z_1_1 too), predictions in data order, with and without the group effects (brms's re_formula = NA reads the residuals of the predictor without them); no newdata

brms.formula: y ~ x + (1 | h) + arma(time = t, gr = g, p = 2, q = 2)

autobayes.formula: y ~ x + (1 | h) + arma(time = t, gr = g, p = 2, q = 2)
